model_source: ../r1_reproduction/PLAN.json; unchanged model; layer potentials plus/minus D in meV
scan: Union of D=40..40.5 step0.05 and D=40.25..40.45 step0.01; forward and reverse. Initial seeds are the two local upper roots recovered at D=40 in the parent report. Keep the last accepted pair across failed stations; reverse starts from the same D=40 seeds, not from claimed roots above the event.

fold.equations: two components of the actual upper two-band Hamiltonian plus det(momentum Jacobian)/10000

indices.D: 40 and finest-step fold D minus 0.01 meV

post_event_minima.D: finest-step fold D plus 0.01 and 0.05 meV, and D=40.5
post_event_minima.method: bounded Nelder-Mead on squared exact two-band gap; three starts: anchor and both parent D40 roots

gap_maps.scope: sampled local box only; not a global minimum or exclusion certificate

stop: Stop a cutoff on computation/affine failure; retain partial results. Retain failed root and minimum attempts. Failed diagnostics mark unresolved evidence rather than relaxing thresholds.
claims_limit: Numerical local fold/annihilation evidence conditional on the finite model, a smooth isolated upper two-band subspace, finite differences and bounded searches. No interval-arithmetic or exhaustive root-absence certificate, full braid acceptance, Euler removal, novelty, or experimental calibration.
